name: Empathy Mapping
deliverable: Synthesized user observations across Says, Thinks, Does, and Feels

steps.text: Draw Says, Thinks, Does, Feels for one real user.
Fill Says and Does first from observed quotes and actions, not from assumptions.
Infer Thinks and Feels from those observations, mark each guess, then name the tension.

failure: The team fills all four quadrants from memory, so Thinks and Feels become invented inner monologue.
intervention: Ask for the quote or action behind each note; if absent, park it in a to-verify corner outside synthesis.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Widely used in design practice; no single documented originator.
